---
name: Request a manual
about: Ask for an appliance manual to be added to the knowledge base
labels: manual
---

**Brand**

**Model**

**Appliance type** (dishwasher, dryer, ...)

**Direct URL of a free, official PDF**
(From the manufacturer's own site or document CDN, no login. Check it downloads
from a script, not just a browser.)

**Source note**
(Where the URL came from and why it is freely downloadable. This goes into
`data/manuals/manifest.yaml`.)

**Does it have an error-code table?** (page number if you know it)

**Terms of use**
Extracted records are committed and shipped in the container image. Please
confirm you have read the manufacturer's terms and that they do not forbid
redistributing extracted facts (codes, meanings, repair steps):

- [ ] I checked the terms of use

You can also add it yourself with one command, see CONTRIBUTING.md.
